setup.title: Welcome to MorniHosting
setup.subtitle: Three short steps and your panel is ready.
setup.languageHint: You can change it any time in your account.
setup.accountHint: This account manages everything. There is no default password, only the one you choose here.
setup.usernameHint: 3 to 32 characters: letters, digits, dot, dash, underscore
setup.passwordHint: At least 10 characters. A sentence of several words is strong and easy to remember.
setup.doneText: Your panel is ready. Next, create your first server; it takes less than a minute.
setup.dockerWarning: Docker is not reachable right now. You can continue, but servers only start once Docker runs.

login.title: Sign in
login.subtitle: Sign in to manage your servers.
login.twoFactorText: Open your authenticator app and enter the 6-digit code for MorniHosting.

dashboard.title: Your servers
dashboard.subtitle: {{running}} of {{total}} servers running · {{players}}
dashboard.emptyText: Create your first Minecraft server. You pick the game version and size, we take care of the rest.
dashboard.emptyImport: Already have a server? Import it as a ZIP.
dashboard.noAccess: No server has been shared with you yet. Ask your administrator for access.

card.moddedHint: Modpacks often need 2 to 3 minutes on their first start.

server.noPermission: You do not have the rights for this on this server.

connection.title: Connection
connection.reachableText: Friends can connect from anywhere. Checked {{time}}.
connection.unreachableText: It works at home but not from outside yet. Usually a port forward is missing: forward {{protocol}} port {{port}} to {{lanIp}} in your router.
connection.unknownText: Check whether friends can reach you from the internet.
connection.notRunning: Start the server to check reachability.
connection.portForwardSteps:
1. Open your router's web interface (often 192.168.0.1 or 192.168.1.1).
2. Look for “Port forwarding”.
3. Add a rule for this device: {{protocol}}, port {{port}}, target {{lanIp}}.
4. Save and click “Check again” here.
connection.playitText: No access to the router? playit.gg makes your server reachable without port forwarding.

stats.noData: No measurements yet. They appear once the server runs.
stats.title: History

console.title: Console
console.placeholder: Type a command, e.g. say hello
console.notRunning: The server is off. Start it to send commands.
console.noPermission: You may not view this server's console.
console.noCommandPermission: You may read the console but not send commands.
console.history: Use ↑ and ↓ for earlier commands, Tab to complete.
console.commandFailed: The command did not reach the server.

out-of-memory.title: Not enough memory
out-of-memory.text: The server had {{memoryMb}} MB and needed more. This often happens with modpacks or many players.
out-of-memory.fix: Give the server more memory (e.g. 2 GB more) and restart it.

wrong-java.title: Wrong Java version
wrong-java.text: Part of the server needs Java {{java}}, but a different version was started.
wrong-java.fix: Set the Java version to “Automatic” or Java {{java}} in the settings.

missing-dependency.title: A required plugin or mod is missing
missing-dependency.fix: Install {{dependency}} from the marketplace or remove {{plugin}}.

port-in-use.title: The port is already in use
port-in-use.text: Another program or server already uses this port.
port-in-use.fix: Pick a free port in the settings (e.g. 25566) and restart.

eula.title: Minecraft EULA not accepted
eula.text: The server does not start without agreeing to the EULA.
eula.fix: Start the server again; MorniHosting sets the agreement automatically.

version-not-found.title: This version does not exist
version-not-found.text: The selected game version could not be downloaded.
version-not-found.fix: Pick a different version in the settings.

mod-version-mismatch.title: Mods do not match the game version
mod-version-mismatch.text: At least one mod was built for a different Minecraft version.
mod-version-mismatch.fix: Check the mods for updates in the marketplace or remove the mismatching mod.

world-broken.title: The world cannot be loaded
world-broken.text: The world files seem to be damaged.
world-broken.fix: Restore a backup. Under “Backups” that takes one click.

plugin-error.title: A plugin is causing trouble
plugin-error.fix: Update {{plugin}} or switch it off under “Plugins” for now.

start-failed.title: The server could not start
start-failed.fix: Check that Docker is running and try again.

unknown.title: Unknown cause
unknown.text: The server stopped unexpectedly (code {{exitCode}}). The last lines below usually give a hint.
unknown.fix: Restart the server. If it happens again, take a close look at the console.

download-failed.title: Game files could not be downloaded
download-failed.text: On its first start the server downloads the game files from the internet. That failed.
download-failed.fix: Check the server's internet connection (DNS, firewall) and start it again.

create.title: New server
create.subtitle: A few steps to your own Minecraft server.
create.editionTitle: Which devices do you play on?
create.javaText: For PC and Mac. Plugins and mods possible.
create.bedrockText: For phones, tablets, consoles and the Windows Store version.

software.paper: Fast and stable, with plugins. The best choice for most.
software.purpur: Like Paper, with many extra settings.
software.vanilla: The original by Mojang, without plugins.
software.fabric: Lightweight for mods such as Sodium or Create.
software.forge: The classic for big mods and modpacks.
software.velocity: A proxy that links several servers into one network.

create.versionHint: Pick the version your friends play.
create.versionsFailed: The version list could not be loaded.
create.sizeHint: We recommend {{recommended}}. More helps with many players and mods.
create.ramFree: About {{free}} is free on the host right now.
create.ramWarn: That is more than the host has free right now.
create.nameTitle: What should your server be called?
create.name: Name
create.portHint: Default is {{port}}. Every server needs its own port.

import.title: Import server
import.subtitle: Upload your existing server folder as a ZIP. World, plugins and settings are kept.
import.drop: Drop the ZIP file here or click
import.dropHint: Up to {{size}}. The folder contents (server.properties, world …) can sit directly in the ZIP or in one subfolder.
